Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Kavindra Singh
Hon'ble Ashwani Kumar Mishra,J.
Hon'ble Syed Aftab Husain Rizvi,J.

This petition has been filed with the prayer to quash the First Information Report, registered as Case Crime No.0458 of 2023, under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 323 and 506 IPC, Police Station-Bairiya, District-Ballia, wherein the allegation is made by the informant that on the strength of a fabricated power of attorney, her niece has executed sale-deed, in favour of petitioner.

The F.I.R. contains specific allegation to the effect that the left hand of the informant is amputated since she was child, whereas the power of attorney contains her finger impressions of all ten fingers.

It is alleged in the F.I.R. that power of attorney is wholly fabricated and the accused has resorted to Faiyaz Ahmad vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/99240200/

sentences.text: preparation of false document and offences under various Sections have even been committed.
The F.I.R. is challenged on the various grounds.

Supplementary affidavit has been filed stating that the proceeding for cancellation of such power of attorney has been instituted and registered on 13.07.2022, whereas the sale-deed was executed on 09.06.2022.
The contents of the cancellation deed has been highlighted in order to submit that the informant herself admitted that the power of attorney was executed by her earlier.
Learned counsel for the petitioner also submits that a suit has been filed, by the petitioner, for permanent injunction, which has since been decreed ex-parte.
It is submitted that till date the suit has not been contested and the informant has not challenged the ex-parte decree before competent court, and that the impugned F.I.R. has instead been lodged.

It is also submitted that the application filed in different district for lodgement of F.I.R. under Section 156(3) Cr.P.C. has been rejected,
therefore, registration of the F.I.R. is also impermissible.

On the other hand, learned counsel for the informant states that informant is a widow with limited education and the contents of the cancellation deed since have been prepared by the deed-writer, as such not much reliance can be placed upon its wordings.
Learned A.G.A. also points out that even in the cancellation deed, it is clearly mentioned that informant's left hand is amputated.

Learned counsel also points out that the power of attorney which is relied upon was executed, on 22.05.2006, whereas the informant has acquired right over the property only on the date of death of her husband i.e. 16.05.2016 and not on 22.05.2006.
The question of executing any power of attorney, for the property, having not yet been acquired, by the informant, could not have arisen.
Statement made in the F.I.R. that since childhood the informant has only right hand, and that her left hand is amputated, is not challenged.
It is also admitted that the power of attorney contains impressions of all ten fingers.
Prima facie, the allegations with regard to commissioning of cognizable offence is disclosed from above.
We are not required to express any definite opinion on the merits of the case as all such issues can be commented only on conclusion of investigation, at first instance.

Since, prima facie,
allegations with regard to commissioning of cognizable offence is disclosed, the prayer made to quash the F.I.R. is declined.
Writ petition stands dismissed, accordingly.
